425:t_1:163.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you need something from us, $n?」

425:t_1:164.en:
$n
「I've finished my daily training. I was hoping someone would be my opponent in a mock battle.」

425:t_1:166.en:
$n
「Tomorrow, we're launching a surprise attack on the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ controlling this whole area. This is sort of a warm-up.」

425:t_1:172.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the last person I want to hear that from.」

425:t_1:173.en:
$n
「I could say the same to you.」

425:t_1:174.en:
$$カレン$$
「Arguing won't make you stronger, $n. I'll be your opponent in a mock battle.」

425:t_1:175.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So you do have a thing for him, right?」

425:t_1:177.en:
$n
「Then I can beat you down without holding back.」

425:t_1:178.en:
$$カレン$$
「Big talk for someone with a record of 12 wins and 46 losses against me.」

425:t_1:179.en:
$n
「I'll get that up to 20 wins before today's over.」

425:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll continue our argument. After $$カレン$$, I'll be your opponent.」

425:t_1:181.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll join in too. I want to get better at using $$ユニコーン$$ myself.」

425:t_1:182.en:
$n
「That helps. Everyone, please lend me your strength.」

425:t_1:183.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(It seems there's no need to worry.)

425:t_2:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Only this section differed from the layout of the other $$ターミナル・ベース$$s. It seems this area had a significant purpose.」

425:t_2:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The block containing this facility is exceptionally strong. That also shows how special this place is.」

425:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And that strength actually spared it from damage when they blew up the base.」

425:t_2:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our surprise attack and lightning offensive must have made them rush their evacuation. That probably contributed to their mistake.」

425:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「What's wrong, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

425:t_2:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I've seen a similar system in the records.」

425:t_2:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The 《$$プロトデビルン$$》's Spiritia Farm Project...」

425:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$... You mean $$シビル$$ and the others...」

425:t_2:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$スピリチア$$... I hear it is the human bioenergy they required to survive...」

425:t_2:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To obtain a steady supply of $$スピリチア$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$'s leader, $$ゲペルニッチ$$...」

425:t_2:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Built a system that abducted and confined humans, then drained their $$スピリチア$$.」

425:t_2:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That was the Spiritia Farm Project...」

425:t_2:19.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「These capsules covering the entire area... They look very much like the Spiritia Farm I saw in the records.」

425:t_2:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As Captain $$ジェフリー$$ suspected, these capsules appear to be designed to hold humans.」

425:t_2:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It's possible that $$サイデリアル$$ is abducting people everywhere to use them in this system.」

425:t_2:23.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「A transmission from Major $$オズマ$$, who is commanding the other team.」

425:t_2:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This is Major $$オズマ・リー$$. We've found civilians held captive by $$サイデリアル$$.」

425:t_2:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We've managed to speak to a few of them. A considerable number were brought here from the $$蒼の地球$$.」

425:t_2:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... From the way you put that, are most of the captives in no condition to speak?」

425:t_2:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's correct. ...Please send $F here to help with the investigation.」

425:t_2:35.en: ～Inside the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ Facility～

425:t_2:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
「As you can see, they all have $$血塗られた眼$$, just like you.」

425:t_2:42.en:
$n
「I had a reaction when we approached this base, but now...」

425:t_2:43.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can you tell us anything?」

425:t_2:44.en:
$n
「I... think $$血塗られた眼$$ develops in people who have come into contact with the $$テンシ$$ that caused the $$時空震動$$.」

425:t_2:45.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then these people came into contact with the $$テンシ$$ too...?」

425:t_2:47.en:
$n
「But I've heard that the symptoms gradually subsided in the people with $$血塗られた眼$$ I know after we defeated $$ガドライト#pilot$$.」

425:t_2:48.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But I've heard you believe $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ are different beings.」

425:t_2:50.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ was certainly my enemy, but I still can't reconcile him with the $$テンシ$$ I saw in the $$時空震動$$ that took Dad and Sis from me.」

425:t_2:51.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Judging from the situation, there is no doubt they were used in that system.」

425:t_2:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we discover what it is, we might learn more about $$血塗られた眼$$ too.」

425:t_2:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...We can't leave them like this. Let's contact the local resistance and ask them to take these people into their care.」

425:t_2:54.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「First, we need to count them and establish as many identities as we can.」

425:t_2:55.en:
$n
(What is this...? What... is happening here...?)

425:t_2:59.en:
$n
「Why are you here!? What on earth happened!?」

425:t_2:63.en:
$n
「Please tell me anything at all, $$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$! Otherwise...!」
